learning_objective: 🎯 Let's get moving! Today we will learn fun ways to travel by walking, running, jumping, and hopping.

main_concepts.simple_explanation: When we walk, one foot is always on the ground. When we run fast, both feet leave the ground for a second like we are flying!
Jumping means pushing off with both feet and landing softly. Hopping means jumping on just one foot and balancing!

fun_activity.title: 🐸 The Animal Walk
fun_activity.instructions: Can you jump high like a frog? Can you waddle like a duck? Show your family your best animal walks around the room!

quick_recap: ⭐ Move your arms back and forth to help you run faster.
⭐ Bend your knees when landing to protect your legs from getting hurt.
